# Draft:Acaster Malbis War Memorial

----
Acaster Malbis War Memorial is a wooden plaque war memorial commemorating the service of villagers during the First World War.
The memorial was opened in 1927 alongside the Memorial Hall it is located in. The memorial includes the name of six men who died in the First World War, as well as a further list of 29 men who served in the conflict but survived.
